note: Curated provider catalog shipped with the plugin. A remote catalog (same schema, served from a raw GitHub URL) can be added in Settings and overrides entries with matching ids. Model IDs change often — always verify against the provider's docs. Ratings are editorial.

providers.name: Anthropic (official)
providers.description: The official Anthropic API. Native Claude models, first-party reliability, full feature support (prompt caching, extended thinking, web search tools).

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: Aggregator with hundreds of models behind one API and one balance. Officially supports Claude Code. Good fallback layer — one key covers many upstream providers.

providers.name: Z.AI (GLM)
providers.description: Zhipu's GLM models via their Anthropic-compatible endpoint. The GLM Coding Plan is a popular flat-rate subscription for coding tools.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.description: DeepSeek's official Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Very cheap per-token pricing; strong reasoning model. No subscription tier.

providers.name: Moonshot Kimi
providers.description: Kimi models via Moonshot's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Long-context strengths; regional variants (api.moonshot.ai for global).

providers.name: AgentRouter
providers.description: Community gateway offering various models (GLM, DeepSeek, etc.) through one endpoint. Claude Code clients only — it fingerprints user-agents.
